```{r setup, include=FALSE}
root_dir <- normalizePath("..")

source(file.path(root_dir, "weather_chart_common.R"))

as_of <- as.Date(params$as_of)
recent_start <- as_of - params$recent_days
local_start <- as.Date(params$local_start)
first_day <- make_date(chart_year, 1, 1)
last_day <- make_date(chart_year, 12, 31)
last_complete_day <- min(as_of - 1, last_day)
```

## Question and definitions

Recreate the existing annual temperature-range and within-month accumulated-rain
chart for the three requested localities. Final locality selection: “ok use 1.
Banashankari; 2. Indiranagar; 3. Bellandur”. This is a chart prototype, not a test of
whether any locality has broken a historical record.

- Unit: station-day, midnight to midnight IST. Expected denominator: 24 distinct
  hours for each metric. Temperature is the minimum and maximum of hourly means;
  rainfall is the sum of derived hourly increments, never the daily counter.
- Require 24 valid hours for the WeatherUnion daily values. For the historical
  Oikolab portion, follow the existing daily chart: use available temperature
  extrema and sum available rainfall, with absent rainfall contributing zero.
  Latest clarification: “no don't keep it blank. how do we do it normally inour daily chart? use the same. if incomplete assume 0.”
- Source switch: following the latest user clarification, use Oikolab
  **ERA5-only** city days before `r local_start`, and WeatherUnion only from that
  date onward. Earlier WeatherUnion readings are deliberately excluded from the
  plotted series. Leave every later station gap unfilled.
  Exact clarification: “Use data only from March 1st fall back to oikOLab until February.”
- Keep the last `r params$recent_days` completed calendar days and today unfilled.
  Do not replace missing recent observations, extrapolate, or use GFS.
- The user explicitly requests a composite: retain each metric's provenance and
  display fallback separately. It is not a homogeneous station climate series.
- Reference: the same Oikolab city grid, 1981 through `r chart_year - 1`, with
  current-year observations excluded. These are city references, not locality normals.
- Rain accumulation stops after an unresolved missing day until the next month.
  Mixed-source months remain visibly marked. The requested zero-rain assumption
  applies to the historical ERA5 portion; later WeatherUnion gaps remain unfilled.
- Stop or narrow if keys repeat, sources cannot be identified, or the requested
  station does not exist. Any apparent spatial difference that depends on fallback
  is weakened; local rankings require matched WeatherUnion days.

## First, check the station archive

```{r stations}
open_dataset(file.path(root_dir, "data/weatherunion_bengaluru_hourly.parquet")) -> archive
archive %>%
  distinct(locality_id, current_locality_name) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(current_locality_name %in% params$localities) -> stations
stopifnot(nrow(stations) == length(params$localities))
start_ist <- as.POSIXct(as.character(first_day), tz = "Asia/Kolkata")
end_ist <- as.POSIXct(as.character(last_complete_day + 1), tz = "Asia/Kolkata")
archive %>%
  filter(
    locality_id %in% stations$locality_id,
    hour_ist >= start_ist,
    hour_ist < end_ist
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(hour_ist, tz = "Asia/Kolkata")) -> wu
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(wu[c("locality_id", "hour_ist")]))
stopifnot(all(wu$rain_mm >= 0 | is.na(wu$rain_mm)))
wu %>%
  summarise(
    first = min(date),
    latest = max(date),
    observed_hours = n(),
    valid_temperature_hours = sum(is.finite(temperature_c)),
    valid_rain_hours = sum(is.finite(rain_mm)),
    .by = locality_id
  ) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = "locality_id") %>%
  mutate(expected_hours = as.integer(latest - first + 1) * 24) -> coverage
coverage
wu %>%
  summarise(
    temp_hours = sum(is.finite(temperature_c)),
    rain_hours = sum(is.finite(rain_mm)),
    low = if (temp_hours == 24) min(temperature_c) else NA_real_,
    high = if (temp_hours == 24) max(temperature_c) else NA_real_,
    rain = if (rain_hours == 24) sum(rain_mm) else NA_real_,
    .by = c(locality_id, date)
  ) -> wu_daily
wu_daily %>%
  summarise(
    days_with_rows = n(),
    full_temp_days = sum(temp_hours == 24),
    full_rain_days = sum(rain_hours == 24),
    .by = locality_id
  ) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = "locality_id")
```

All three selected stations have 206 complete days each, covering every hour
from February 22 through September 15 for both temperature and rainfall.
Hourly coverage does not guarantee all 60 minutes were sampled or certify sensor accuracy.

## Prepare the city reference separately

Use explicit IST dates for both sources. ERA5 samples are on the half-hour in IST;
WeatherUnion timestamps name hourly intervals. Their daily summaries are comparable
context, not identical measurement procedures.

```{r era5}
load(file.path(root_dir, "data", "bangaloreTemperature.RData"))
load(file.path(root_dir, "data", "bangaloreRainfall.RData"))
as_tibble(blrTemp) %>%
  filter(Source == "era5") %>%
  transmute(
    timestamp = DT,
    date = as.Date(DT, tz = "Asia/Kolkata"),
    temp = as.numeric(Temp)
  ) -> era_temp
as_tibble(blrRain) %>%
  filter(Source == "era5") %>%
  transmute(
    timestamp = DT,
    date = as.Date(DT, tz = "Asia/Kolkata"),
    rain = as.numeric(Rain)
  ) -> era_rain
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(era_temp$timestamp), !anyDuplicated(era_rain$timestamp))
era_temp %>%
  summarise(
    hours = sum(is.finite(temp)),
    era_low = if (hours > 0) min(temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    era_high = if (hours > 0) max(temp, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .by = date
  ) -> era_temp_daily
era_rain %>%
  summarise(
    hours = sum(is.finite(rain)),
    # Match the daily chart: absent rainfall contributes zero, per user instruction.
    era_rain = sum(rain, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = date
  ) -> era_rain_daily
era_temp_daily %>%
  select(-hours) %>%
  full_join(select(era_rain_daily, -hours), by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(yr = year(date), month = month(date), day = day(date)) -> era_daily
era_daily %>%
  summarise(
    first_available_temp = min(date[is.finite(era_low)]),
    latest_available_temp = max(date[is.finite(era_low)]),
    latest_available_rain = max(date[is.finite(era_rain)])
  )
era_daily %>%
  filter(yr < chart_year, is.finite(era_low), is.finite(era_high)) %>%
  summarise(
    reference_low = min(era_low),
    reference_high = max(era_high),
    normal_low = median(era_low),
    normal_high = median(era_high),
    reference_years = n(),
    .by = c(month, day)
  ) %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(chart_year, month, day)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) -> temp_reference
era_daily %>%
  filter(yr < chart_year) %>%
  group_by(yr, month) %>%
  filter(n() == days_in_month(first(date)), all(is.finite(era_rain))) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(cumulative = cumsum(era_rain)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    p10 = quantile(cumulative, 0.10),
    p25 = quantile(cumulative, 0.25),
    median = median(cumulative),
    p75 = quantile(cumulative, 0.75),
    p90 = quantile(cumulative, 0.90),
    reference_years = n(),
    .by = c(month, day)
  ) %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(chart_year, month, day)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date), date <= last_complete_day) -> rain_reference
```

## Keep the source with every value

```{r composite}
crossing(
  locality_id = stations$locality_id,
  date = seq(first_day, last_complete_day, by = "day")
) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = "locality_id") %>%
  left_join(select(coverage, locality_id, first), by = "locality_id") %>%
  left_join(wu_daily, by = c("locality_id", "date")) %>%
  left_join(select(era_daily, date, era_low, era_high, era_rain), by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    fallback_allowed = date < recent_start & date < local_start,
    temp_source = case_when(
      date >= local_start & is.finite(low) & is.finite(high) ~ "WeatherUnion",
      fallback_allowed & is.finite(era_low) & is.finite(era_high) ~ "Oikolab fallback",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    ),
    rain_source = case_when(
      date >= local_start & is.finite(rain) ~ "WeatherUnion",
      fallback_allowed ~ "Oikolab fallback",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    ),
    low = case_when(
      temp_source == "WeatherUnion" ~ low,
      temp_source == "Oikolab fallback" ~ era_low,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    high = case_when(
      temp_source == "WeatherUnion" ~ high,
      temp_source == "Oikolab fallback" ~ era_high,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    rain = case_when(
      rain_source == "WeatherUnion" ~ rain,
      rain_source == "Oikolab fallback" ~ coalesce(era_rain, 0),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(locality_id, month) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative = cumsum(rain),
    cumulative_has_fallback = cumany(rain_source == "Oikolab fallback"),
    cumulative_source = case_when(
      is.na(cumulative) ~ "Missing",
      cumulative_has_fallback ~ "Includes Oikolab fallback",
      TRUE ~ "WeatherUnion"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() -> daily
# These are data-integrity checks on the actual analysis, not a test suite.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(daily[c("locality_id", "date")]))
stopifnot(!any(daily$temp_source == "Oikolab fallback" & daily$date >= recent_start))
stopifnot(!any(daily$rain_source == "Oikolab fallback" & daily$date >= recent_start))
daily %>%
  count(current_locality_name, temp_source, rain_source) -> source_counts
source_counts
stopifnot(!any(daily$temp_source == "Oikolab fallback" & daily$date >= local_start))
stopifnot(!any(daily$rain_source == "Oikolab fallback" & daily$date >= local_start))
stopifnot(!any(daily$temp_source == "WeatherUnion" & daily$date < local_start))
stopifnot(!any(daily$rain_source == "WeatherUnion" & daily$date < local_start))
# Sensitivity: does a 20-hour rule rescue many WeatherUnion days?
wu_daily %>%
  summarise(
    temp_days_24h = sum(temp_hours == 24),
    temp_days_20h = sum(temp_hours >= 20),
    rain_days_24h = sum(rain_hours == 24),
    .by = locality_id
  ) %>%
  left_join(stations, by = "locality_id")
```

## Make the three charts

Keep the daily range bars and monthly rainfall curves from the existing chart.
Use identical axes for the three places. The existing plum colour means station
observations; charcoal means fallback. For rainfall, charcoal means the running
monthly total includes at least one fallback day, even if later days are local.
The city reference stays in the existing muted beige palette. Solid versus dashed
rain lines reinforce provenance without relying solely on hue.

The canvas reserves headings outside each panel, a short source key under each
panel title, and four footer lines. Whole-degree temperature ticks and 50 mm rain
ticks are enough for the spread; no daily labels compete with the annual pattern.
The axes remain because readers need to estimate hundreds of unlabelled values.

```{r build-charts, results='hide'}
source_colours <- c(
  "WeatherUnion" = weather_palette$actual,
  "Oikolab fallback" = "#52616a",
  "Includes Oikolab fallback" = "#52616a"
)
temp_limits <- range(
  temp_reference$reference_low,
  temp_reference$reference_high,
  daily$low,
  daily$high,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
temp_limits <- c(floor(temp_limits[1] / 4) * 4, ceiling(temp_limits[2] / 4) * 4)
rain_top <- ceiling(max(daily$cumulative, rain_reference$p90, na.rm = TRUE) / 50) * 50
month_breaks <- weather_month_midpoints(chart_year)
x_scale <- function(position = "bottom") {
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(first_day - 1, last_day + 1),
    breaks = month_breaks$x,
    labels = toupper(month.abb),
    position = position,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
}
base_theme <- weather_chart_theme(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.line.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(b = 9)),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 12, 10, 12)
  )
plots <- list()
for (place in params$localities) {
  daily %>%
    filter(current_locality_name == place) -> d
  ggplot(temp_reference, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = weather_month_starts(chart_year),
      colour = weather_palette$normal,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = reference_low, ymax = reference_high),
      fill = weather_palette$record
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = normal_low, ymax = normal_high),
      fill = weather_palette$normal
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      data = filter(d, temp_source != "Missing"),
      aes(ymin = low, ymax = high, colour = temp_source),
      linewidth = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = source_colours) +
    x_scale("top") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(temp_limits[1], temp_limits[2], 4)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = temp_limits) +
    labs(
      title = "Temperature",
      subtitle = "Daily range: plum = WeatherUnion; charcoal = Oikolab fallback. Beige = city history; darker beige = median high/low.",
      x = NULL,
      y = "°C"
    ) +
    base_theme -> temperature_plot
  ggplot(rain_reference, aes(x = date, group = month)) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = weather_month_starts(chart_year),
      colour = weather_palette$normal,
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p10, ymax = p90), fill = weather_palette$band_outer) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75), fill = weather_palette$band_inner) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = weather_palette$normal, linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(y = cumulative, colour = cumulative_source, linetype = cumulative_source),
      linewidth = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = source_colours) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("WeatherUnion" = "solid", "Includes Oikolab fallback" = "22", "Missing" = "solid")
    ) +
    x_scale() +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, rain_top, 50)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, rain_top)) +
    labs(
      title = "Rain accumulated within each month",
      subtitle = "Solid plum = WeatherUnion only; dashed charcoal = includes fallback. Beige = city 10–90% / 25–75% bands; thin line = median.",
      x = NULL,
      y = "mm"
    ) +
    base_theme -> rain_plot
  local_days <- sum(d$temp_source == "WeatherUnion")
  fallback_days <- sum(d$temp_source == "Oikolab fallback")
  missing_days <- sum(d$temp_source == "Missing")
  latest_local <- max(d$date[d$temp_source == "WeatherUnion"])
  caption <- paste0(
    "Sources: WeatherUnion station observations; Oikolab ERA5 city grid. Historical reference: 1981–", chart_year - 1,
    ". Station hourly-mean extrema are not minute-level extremes.\n",
    "Temperature coverage: ", local_days, " local days; ", fallback_days, " fallback days; ", missing_days,
    " unfilled days. Latest complete local day: ", format(latest_local, "%d %b"), ".\n",
    "Oikolab before ", format(local_start, "%d %b"), "; WeatherUnion from then onward. Later gaps stay blank. City history is not a locality record.\n",
    "Oikolab uses available temperature extrema; missing historical rainfall counts as zero, as in the daily chart."
  )
  temperature_plot / rain_plot +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1.65, 1)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0(place, "'s weather in ", chart_year),
      subtitle = paste0("Bangalore | Through ", format(last_complete_day, "%d %B"), " | Local observations with historical city fallback"),
      caption = caption,
      theme = theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = weather_palette$background, colour = NA),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", size = 24, face = "bold", colour = weather_palette$text),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(family = "serif", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        plot.caption = element_text(family = "serif", size = 9, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.25, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        plot.margin = margin(16, 18, 14, 18)
      )
    ) -> p
  plots[[place]] <- p
  ggsave(
    file.path(chart_dir, paste0(tolower(place), "-weather-", chart_year, ".png")),
    p,
    width = 15,
    height = 8.5,
    dpi = 180,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    bg = weather_palette$background
  )
}
```

## Checks and verdict

The full date grid preserves absent days, and missing recent values never select
ERA5. A 20-hour temperature threshold does not rescue any additional days in this
snapshot. Historical rainfall uses the requested zero assumption; unresolved
WeatherUnion gaps still stop monthly accumulation. References exclude 2026 and GFS; axes match across localities.
Rendered outputs are inspected for source identification, complete units, shared
scales, clipping and text overlap. The full-year temperature context is retained
as requested; rain reference bands stop at the reporting date.

Insightful: no

These charts establish that the proposed format is feasible for all three selected
stations. The common city fallback ends February 28, using available readings
and assuming zero rainfall for missing historical hours as requested. They do not yet establish a robust
new climate or neighbourhood claim beyond a daily-chart reading, so there is no
blog publication or change to the scheduled daily chart job.
